newsitem.title: RUSSIA: U.S. Albright to visit Russia on February 20-21.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Albright to visit Russia on February 20-21.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright is to visit Moscow on February 20-21 for talks with Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov, a Foreign Ministry spokesman said on Satruday.
U.S officials said on Friday that Albright was planning to visit nine European and Asian capitals, including Moscow, on her first overseas trip planned for February 15-25.
She is also expected to visit London, Paris, Bonn, Brussels, Rome, Tokyo, Seoul and Beijing.
The Russian Foreign Ministry spokesman gave no details of the agenda for Albright's talks with Primakov.
Senior Foreign Ministry officials have said, however, that NATO's plans to grant full membership to some of Moscow's Cold War allies in eastern Europe would be high on the agenda.

Moscow strongly opposes the Western alliance's expansion plans. But after NATO made clear that Russia's objections could not stop the expansion, Moscow has moved to work out a deal with the alliance to guarantee its national security interests.

Later in February Primakov is expected to meet the German, Italian and British foreign ministers and hold a second round of talks with NATO Secretary General Javier Solana whom he met initially in January.
President Boris Yeltsin is to discuss NATO expansion plans with French President Jaques Chirac who visits Moscow on Sunday.
